classification.difficultyReason: Continue a sequence by repeatedly adding two across negative integers.

content.prompt:
The sequence $-15,-13,-11,\ldots$ is ‘going up by twos’. Write down the next three terms.

(Draw a number line to help you.)

$$\begin{align*}-11+2&=-9\\-9+2&=-7\\-7+2&=-5\end{align*}$$

The next three terms are $-9,-7,-5$.

inlines.text: The table below shows the temperatures inside and outside a building on different days.
For each day, calculate (Temperature inside − Temperature outside). What does it mean if the result of this calculation is negative?

answer.short:
In table order: $-5^\circ\mathrm{C},\ -5^\circ\mathrm{C},\ 4^\circ\mathrm{C},\ 15^\circ\mathrm{C},\ 5^\circ\mathrm{C},\ 9^\circ\mathrm{C}$.

A negative result means it is warmer outside than inside.
answer.worked:
Subtract the outside temperature from the inside temperature. When subtracting a negative integer, add its opposite.

Monday: $20-25=-5^\circ\mathrm{C}$.

Tuesday: $13-18=-5^\circ\mathrm{C}$.

Wednesday: $24-20=4^\circ\mathrm{C}$.

Thursday:
$$\begin{align*}10-(-5)&=10+5\\10-(-5)&=15^\circ\mathrm{C}.\end{align*}$$
Friday:
$$\begin{align*}-5-(-10)&=-5+10\\-5-(-10)&=5^\circ\mathrm{C}.\end{align*}$$
Saturday:
$$\begin{align*}3-(-6)&=3+6\\3-(-6)&=9^\circ\mathrm{C}.\end{align*}$$
A negative result means the inside temperature is lower than the outside temperature, so it is warmer outside.
